source.title: Curriculum for Excellence experiences and outcomes

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have experienced the energy and excitement of presenting/performing for audiences and being part of an audience for other people’s presentations/performances.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have the opportunity to choose and explore a range of media and technologies to create images and objects, discovering their effects and suitability for specific tasks.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can create and present work using the visual elements of line, shape, form, colour, tone, pattern and texture.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can create a range of visual information through observing and recording from my experiences across the curriculum.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Inspired by a range of stimuli, I can express and communicate my ideas, thoughts and feelings through activities within art and design.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use exploration and imagination to solve design problems related to real-life situations.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the work of artists and designers by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I enjoy creating short dance sequences, using travel, turn, jump, gesture, pause and fall, within safe practice.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Inspired by a range of stimuli, I can express my ideas, thoughts and feelings through creative work in dance.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I am becoming aware of different features of dance and can practise and perform steps, formations and short dance.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the experience of dance by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I enjoy creating, choosing and accepting roles, using movement, expression and voice.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Inspired by a range of stimuli, I can express and communicate my ideas, thoughts and feelings through drama.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have developed confidence and skills in creating and presenting drama which explores real and imaginary situations, using improvisation and script.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can respond to the experience of drama by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can sing and play music from other styles and cultures, showing growing confidence and skill while learning about musical notation and performance directions.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I can use my voice, musical instruments and music technology to discover and enjoy playing with sound, rhythm, pitch and dynamics.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: Inspired by a range of stimuli, and working on my own and/or with others, I can express and communicate my ideas, thoughts and feelings through musical activities.

statements.subject: Expressive arts
statements.text: I have listened to a range of music and can respond by discussing my thoughts and feelings. I can give and accept constructive comment on my own and others’ work.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of and able to express my feelings and am developing the ability to talk about them.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I know that we all experience a variety of thoughts and emotions that affect how we feel and behave and I am learning ways of managing them.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that there are people I can talk to and that there are a number of ways in which I can gain access to practical and emotional support to help me and others in a range of circumstances.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that my feelings and reactions can change depending upon what is happening within and around me. This helps me to understand my own behaviour and the way others behave.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I know that friendship, caring, sharing, fairness, equality and love are important in building positive relationships. As I develop and value relationships, I care and show respect for myself and others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand the importance of mental wellbeing and that this can be fostered and strengthened through personal coping skills and positive relationships. I know that it is not always possible to enjoy good mental health and that if this happens there is support available.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning skills and strategies which will support me in challenging times, particularly in relation to change and loss.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Mental and emotional wellbeing
statements.text: I understand that people can feel alone and can be misunderstood and left out by others. I am learning how to give appropriate support.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: As I explore the rights to which I and others are entitled, I am able to exercise these rights appropriately and accept the responsibilities that go with them. I show respect for the rights of others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I recognise that each individual has a unique blend of abilities and needs. I contribute to making my school community one which values individuals equally and is a welcoming place for all.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I make full use of and value the opportunities I am given to improve and manage my learning and, in turn, I can help to encourage learning and confidence in others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: Representing my class, school and/or wider community encourages my self-worth and confidence and allows me to contribute to and participate in society.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: Through contributing my views, time and talents, I play a part in bringing about positive change in my school and wider community.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Social wellbeing
statements.text: I value the opportunities I am given to make friends and be part of a group in a range of situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I am developing my understanding of the human body and can use this knowledge to maintain and improve my wellbeing and health.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning to assess and manage risk, to protect myself and others, and to reduce the potential for harm when possible.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I know and can demonstrate how to keep myself and others safe and how to respond in a range of emergency situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Mental, emotional, social and physical wellbeing: Physical wellbeing
statements.text: I know and can demonstrate how to travel safely.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: Through taking part in a variety of events and activities, I am learning to recognise my own skills and abilities as well as those of others.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I can describe some of the kinds of work that people do and I am finding out about the wider world of work.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: I am discovering ways that I can link actions and skills to create movement patterns and sequences. This has motivated me to practise and improve my skills to develop control and flow.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Movement skills, competencies and concepts
statements.text: I am developing skills and techniques and improving my level of performance and fitness.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Cooperation and competition
statements.text: I can follow and understand rules and procedures, developing my ability to achieve personal goals. I recognise and can adopt different roles in a range of practical activities.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical education: Evaluating and appreciating
statements.text: I can recognise progress and achievement by discussing my thoughts and feelings and giving and accepting feedback.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and sport
statements.text: Within and beyond my place of learning I am enjoying daily opportunities to participate in physical activities and sport, making use of available indoor and outdoor space.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and health
statements.text: I am aware of the role physical activity plays in keeping me healthy and know that I also need to sleep and rest, to look after my body.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Physical education, physical activity and sport: Physical activity and health
statements.text: I understand that my body needs energy to function and that this comes from the food I eat. I am exploring how physical activity contributes to my health and wellbeing.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I enjoy eating a diversity of foods in a range of social situations.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: By investigating the range of foods available I can discuss how they contribute to a healthy diet.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I experience a sense of enjoyment and achievement when preparing simple healthy foods and drinks.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am beginning to understand that nutritional needs change at different stages of life, for example the role of breastfeeding in infant nutrition.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Safe and hygienic practices
statements.text: I am becoming aware of how cleanliness, hygiene and safety can affect health and wellbeing and I apply this knowledge in my everyday routines such as taking care of my teeth.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: When preparing and cooking a variety of foods, I am becoming aware of the journeys which foods make from source to consumer, their seasonality, their local availability and their sustainability.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.strand: Food and health: Food and the consumer
statements.text: I am discovering the different ways that advertising and the media can affect my choices.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know that there are medicines and some other substances that can be used in a safe way to improve health and I am becoming aware of how choices I make can affect my health and wellbeing.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know how to react in unsafe situations and emergencies.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of how friendships are formed and that likes, dislikes, special qualities and needs can influence relationships.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I understand positive things about friendships and relationships but when something worries or upsets me I know who I should talk to.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I know that there are people in our lives who care for and look after us and I am aware that people may be cared for by parents, carers or other adults.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of the need to respect personal space and boundaries and can recognise and respond appropriately to verbal and non-verbal communication.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I recognise that we have similarities and differences but are all unique.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am aware of my growing body and I am learning the correct names for its different parts and how they work.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning what I can do to look after my body and who can help me.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning about respect for my body and what behaviour is right and wrong. I know who I should talk to if I am worried about this.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am learning about where living things come from and about how they grow, develop and are nurtured.

statements.subject: Health and wellbeing
statements.text: I am able to show an awareness of the tasks required to look after a baby.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I can take part in play activities and games linked to simple poems, familiar stories and short role plays, and pronounce familiar Gaelic words and phrases.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can respond verbally and non-verbally to a range of requests from teachers and others.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can use familiar words and phrases to give simple information.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can ask for help using simple or familiar learned phrases or words.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: When joining in with story-telling, games, rhymes, songs and poems in Gaelic, I can use familiar words and simple phrases.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Organising and using information
statements.text: I can listen and respond in different ways to the experiences of others when exploring aspects of Gaelic culture.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Using knowledge about language
statements.text: When reading on my own or with others, I can read familiar words and simple phrases and sentences.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have worked on my own and with others and I can demonstrate my understanding of words, signs and phrases containing familiar language.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have worked with others to read and discuss simple Gaelic texts. I can share simple facts about the life of Gaelic communities in Scotland.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.strand: Reading: Reading for interest and enjoyment
statements.text: I enjoy engaging with simple texts on my own and with others.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I have explored sounds, letters and words, discovering how they work together, and can use what I have learned to help me read.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can write familiar words and simple phrases in Gaelic.

statements.subject: Gaelic (learners)
statements.text: I can use a variety of sources to help me check the accuracy of my Gaelic spelling and punctuation.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Enjoyment and choice
statements.text: I regularly select and listen to or watch texts which I enjoy and find interesting, and I can explain why I prefer certain sources. I regularly select subject, purpose, format and resources to create texts of my choice.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Tools for listening and talking
statements.text: When I engage with others, I know when and how to listen, when to talk, how much to say, when to ask questions and how to respond with respect.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Tools for listening and talking
statements.text: I am exploring how pace, gesture, expression, emphasis and choice of words are used to engage others, and I can use what I learn.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Finding and using information
statements.text: As I listen or watch, I can identify and discuss the purpose, key words and main ideas of the text, and use this information for a specific purpose.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Finding and using information
statements.text: As I listen or watch, I am learning to make notes under given headings and use these to understand what I have listened to or watched and create new texts.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Finding and using information
statements.text: I can select ideas and relevant information, organise these in a logical sequence and use words which will be interesting and/or useful for others.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Understanding, analysing and evaluating
statements.text: I can show my understanding of what I listen to or watch by responding to and asking different kinds of questions.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Understanding, analysing and evaluating
statements.text: To help me develop an informed view, I am learning to recognise the difference between fact and opinion.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: When listening and talking with others for different purposes, I can exchange information, experiences, explanations, ideas and opinions, and clarify points by asking questions or by asking others to say more.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can communicate clearly when engaging with others within and beyond my place of learning, using selected resources as required.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I regularly select and read, listen to or watch texts which I enjoy and find interesting, and I can explain why I prefer certain texts and authors.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can use my knowledge of sight vocabulary, phonics, context clues, punctuation and grammar to read with understanding and expression.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I am learning to select and use strategies and resources before I read, and as I read, to help make the meaning of texts clear.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: Using what I know about the features of different types of texts, I can find, select, sort and use information for a specific purpose.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I am learning to make notes under given headings and use them to understand information, explore ideas and problems and create new texts.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: To show my understanding across different areas of learning, I can identify and consider the purpose and main ideas of a text.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: To show my understanding, I can respond to different kinds of questions and other close reading tasks and I am learning to create some questions of my own.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: To help me develop an informed view, I can recognise the difference between fact and opinion.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can share my thoughts about structure, characters and/or setting, recognise the writer’s message and relate it to my own experiences, and comment on the effective choice of words and other features.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I enjoy creating texts of my choice and I regularly select subject, purpose, format and resources to suit the needs of my audience.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can spell the most commonly-used words, using my knowledge of letter patterns and spelling rules and use resources to help me spell tricky or unfamiliar words.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can write independently, use appropriate punctuation and order and link my sentences in a way that makes sense.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: Throughout the writing process, I can check that my writing makes sense.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can present my writing in a way that will make it legible and attractive for my reader, combining words, images and other features.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I am learning to use my notes and other types of writing to help me understand information and ideas, explore problems, generate and develop ideas or create new text.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: By considering the type of text I am creating, I can select ideas and relevant information, organise these in a logical sequence and use words which will be interesting and/or useful for others.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can convey information, describe events or processes, share my opinions or persuade my reader in different ways.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: I can describe and share my experiences and how they made me feel.

statements.subject: Literacy and English
statements.text: Having explored the elements which writers use in different genres, I can use what I learn to create my own stories, poems and plays with interesting structures, characters and/or settings.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I explore the patterns and sounds of language through songs and rhymes and show understanding verbally or non-verbally

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I am learning to take an active part in daily routines, responding to simple instructions which are accompanied by gesture and expression.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening for information
statements.text: I can listen to and show understanding of language from familiar voices and sources.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I am beginning to identify key information from a short predictable conversation and react with words and/or gesture

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I am beginning to share information about myself using familiar vocabulary and basic language structures.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: With support I am becoming an active listener and can understand, ask and answer simple questions to share information.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I enjoy listening to stories, songs, rhymes and poems in the language I am learning by joining in and responding to show my understanding.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Listening and talking with others
statements.text: I can participate in a range of collaborative activities.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Organising and using information
statements.text: Through a variety of media, I am developing an awareness of social, cultural and geographical aspects of locations in a country where the language I am learning is spoken.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Using knowledge about language
statements.text: I am beginning to explore similarities and differences between sound patterns in different languages through play, rhymes, songs and discussion.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Listening and talking: Using knowledge about language
statements.text: I can use my knowledge about language and pronunciation to ensure that others can understand me when I say familiar words and phrases.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.text: I can recognise labels and environmental print. I am beginning to organise images and text. With support, I can sequence images and text to demonstrate my understanding.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.text: I can work on my own or with others to demonstrate my understanding of words and phrases containing familiar language.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Reading: Reading to appreciate other cultures
statements.text: I am beginning to recognise similarities and differences between Scotland and a country where the language I am learning is spoken, using varied simple texts, visual prompts and media.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.strand: Reading: Reading for interest and enjoyment
statements.text: I have experienced a variety of simple texts, which may have been adapted for young learners.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.text: I am beginning to use illustrated word-banks, picture prompts, picture dictionaries and displays to support my understanding of simple texts.

statements.subject: Modern languages
statements.text: With support, I am beginning to experiment with writing in the language I am learning

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Estimation and rounding
statements.text: I can share ideas with others to develop ways of estimating the answer to a calculation or problem, work out the actual answer, then check my solution by comparing it with the estimate.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Number and number processes
statements.text: I have investigated how whole numbers are constructed, can understand the importance of zero within the system and can use my knowledge to explain the link between a digit, its place and its value.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Number and number processes
statements.text: I can use addition, subtraction, multiplication and division when solving problems, making best use of the mental strategies and written skills I have developed.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Fractions, decimal fractions and percentages
statements.text: Having explored fractions by taking part in practical activities, I can show my understanding of: • how a single item can be shared equally • the notation and vocabulary associated with fractions • where simple fractions lie on the number line.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Fractions, decimal fractions and percentages
statements.text: Through exploring how groups of items can be shared equally, I can find a fraction of an amount by applying my knowledge of division.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Fractions, decimal fractions and percentages
statements.text: Through taking part in practical activities including use of pictorial representations, I can demonstrate my understanding of simple fractions which are equivalent.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I can use money to pay for items and can work out how much change I should receive.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I have investigated how different combinations of coins and notes can be used to pay for goods or be given in change.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I can tell the time using 12 hour clocks, realising there is a link with 24 hour notation, explain how it impacts on my daily routine and ensure that I am organised and ready for events throughout my day.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I can use a calendar to plan and be organised for key events for myself and my class throughout the year.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I have begun to develop a sense of how long tasks take by measuring the time taken to complete a range of activities using a variety of timers.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I can estimate how long or heavy an object is, or what amount it holds, using everyday things as a guide, then measure or weigh it using appropriate instruments and units.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I can estimate the area of a shape by counting squares or other methods.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Mathematics - its impact on the world, past, present and future
statements.text: I have discussed the important part that numbers play in the world and explored a variety of systems that have been used by civilisations throughout history to record numbers.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Patterns and relationships
statements.text: I can continue and devise more involved repeating patterns or designs, using a variety of media.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Patterns and relationships
statements.text: Through exploring number patterns, I can recognise and continue simple number sequences and can explain the rule I have applied.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Expressions and equations
statements.text: I can compare, describe and show number relationships, using appropriate vocabulary and the symbols for equals, not equal to, less than and greater than.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Number, money and measure: Expressions and equations
statements.text: When a picture or symbol is used to replace a number in a number statement, I can find its value using my knowledge of number facts and explain my thinking to others.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Shape, position and movement: Properties of 2D shapes and 3D objects
statements.text: I have explored simple 3D objects and 2D shapes and can identify, name and describe their features using appropriate vocabulary.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Shape, position and movement: Properties of 2D shapes and 3D objects
statements.text: I can explore and discuss how and why different shapes fit together and create a tiling pattern with them.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Shape, position and movement: Angle, symmetry and transformation
statements.text: I can describe, follow and record routes and journeys using signs, words and angles associated with direction and turning.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Shape, position and movement: Angle, symmetry and transformation
statements.text: I have developed an awareness of where grid reference systems are used in everyday contexts and can use them to locate and describe position.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Shape, position and movement: Angle, symmetry and transformation
statements.text: I have explored symmetry in my own and the wider environment and can create and recognise symmetrical pictures, patterns and shapes.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I have explored a variety of ways in which data is presented and can ask and answer questions about the information it contains.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: I have used a range of ways to collect information and can sort it in a logical, organised and imaginative way using my own and others’ criteria.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.text: Using technology and other methods, I can display data simply, clearly and accurately by creating tables, charts and diagrams, using simple labelling and scale.

statements.subject: Numeracy and mathematics
statements.strand: Information handling: Ideas of chance and uncertainty
statements.text: I can use appropriate vocabulary to describe the likelihood of events occurring, using the knowledge and experiences of myself and others to guide me.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: Through exploring Bible stories, I can describe some beliefs Christians have about God and Jesus.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: By exploring some places and investigating artefacts, I am developing my knowledge of Christian beliefs and my awareness of the role of Christianity in Scottish society and the world.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I can talk about my own beliefs, or express them in other ways.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: Having explored biblical and other Christian stories, I can show my developing understanding of key values of Christianity and how they might be put into action in people’s lives and communities.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I can describe the key features of the values of Christianity which are expressed in stories.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: Through investigating the Christian communities in my local area, I am discovering how Christian communities demonstrate their beliefs through prayer, worship and special ceremonies. I am developing respect for the practices and traditions of others.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I am developing an awareness of the ways in which Christians celebrate different times of year and can relate these to my own life and community.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Beliefs
statements.text: Through exploring stories from world religions, I can describe some of their key beliefs.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Beliefs
statements.text: By exploring some places and investigating artefacts, I am developing my knowledge of the beliefs of world religions and my awareness of their role in Scottish society and the world.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Beliefs
statements.text: I can talk about my own beliefs, or express them in other ways.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Values and issues
statements.text: Having explored stories from world religions, I can show my developing understanding of key values of those faiths and how they might be put into action in people’s lives and communities.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Values and issues
statements.text: I can describe the key features of the values of world religions which are expressed in stories.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Practices and traditions
statements.text: I am discovering how followers of world religions demonstrate their beliefs through prayer/meditation, worship and special ceremonies. I am developing respect for the practices and traditions of others.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.strand: World religions selected for study: Practices and traditions
statements.text: I am developing an awareness of the ways in which followers of world religions celebrate different times of year and can relate these to my own life and community.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I am developing respect for others and my understanding of their beliefs and values.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I am developing an increasing awareness and understanding of my own beliefs and I put them into action in positive ways.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I am developing an awareness that some people have beliefs and values which are independent of religion.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I can show my understanding of values such as caring, sharing, fairness, equality and love.

statements.subject: Religious and moral education
statements.text: I am becoming aware that people’s beliefs and values affect their actions.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I am discovering God’s precious gift of life and reflect on how this reveals God’s love for me.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: In the Image of God
statements.text: I know that a loving God has created me and that my uniqueness can develop according to God’s plan for me.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: Revealed Truth of God
statements.text: I am exploring God’s relationship with others and I have reflected on how people’s faith has helped them in difficult times.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Catholic Christianity: Revealed Truth of God
statements.text: I can describe God as Father, Son and Holy Spirit and I have reflected on how God can support me in my life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I am familiar with the Christmas story and I know that at Christmas we celebrate the birth of Jesus the Son of God and Son of Mary.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have examined some political, social, historical and religious elements in first-century Palestine and gained an understanding of Jesus’ life on earth.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have examined the role of Jesus as a teacher and a healer and I have reflected on how His words and actions influence my own life and the lives of others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the events of the Passion, Death and Resurrection of Jesus and I have reflected on the Catholic meaning of eternal life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that through the Community of the Church, people can experience God’s love and care and I have reflected on how this community celebrates together.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I am exploring the Sacraments of Initiation and Reconciliation and I have reflected on how the Sacraments help to nurture faith.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have examined the role of the Holy Spirit in my life and in the lives of others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can share some Bible stories and I can explore how God speaks to us through these stories. I have reflected on how these stories can help me to live a Christian life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that the Bible is the inspired Word of God and that I should treat it with reverence.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I recognise the importance of personal prayer and communal prayer in the growth of all people’s relationship with God. I know a number of traditional Catholic prayers and I have developed an understanding of the meaning of these prayers. I have participated in different approaches to, and experiences of, prayer. I can describe how prayer is an important part of the liturgical and devotional life of the Church. I have reflected on how all of these are different ways of worshipping God.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I can honour Mary as Mother of Jesus and Our Mother. I can share why we honour her.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that the Mass is at the heart of Catholic community life and I am developing an understanding of how to participate fully in this celebration.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have, through liturgical experiences, reflected on an ability to respond to symbols and take part in rituals in order to worship God.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know some of the signs and symbols related to Lent, Easter, Pentecost, Advent and Christmastide and I can use this understanding to help me explore the themes of these celebrations.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that the Holy Spirit strengthens my faith and the faith of the saints and I have reflected on how the stories of the Saints can inspire me to live a more Christian life.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that I have been called by God to grow in love, justice and peace in my relationships with others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the implications of Jesus’ command to love God and love my neighbour.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have explored the call to forgiveness and reconciliation and have reflected on how this can restore my relationship with God and others. I can put this understanding into practice in my relationship with God and others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I know that God has given me the freedom to make choices about the way I live my life. I have reflected on how the decisions of my conscience affect my relationship with God and others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I have considered ways in which the Catholic Christian community works together to show care for the world and for the needs of all people. I have reflected on the implications of this for my life and that of others.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.text: I am aware that the Jewish and/or Muslim communities believe in God.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Other world religions: Values and issues
statements.text: I am aware of family and community values in the Jewish and/or Muslim faiths.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Other world religions: Practices and traditions
statements.text: I can identify the places of worship of the Jewish and/or Muslim faith communities.

statements.subject: Religious education in Roman Catholic schools
statements.strand: Other world religions: Practices and traditions
statements.text: I know that the Jewish and/or Muslim communities have special books which are important to their beliefs.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can distinguish between living and non living things. I can sort living things into groups and explain my decisions.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can explore examples of food chains and show an appreciation of how animals and plants depend on each other for food.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can help to design experiments to find out what plants need in order to grow and develop. I can observe and record my findings and from what I have learned I can grow healthy plants in school.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Energy sources and sustainability
statements.text: I am aware of different types of energy around me and can show their importance to everyday life and my survival.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Planet Earth: Processes of the planet
statements.text: By investigating how water can change from one form to another, I can relate my findings to everyday experiences.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By safely observing and recording the sun and moon at various times, I can describe their patterns of movement and changes over time. I can relate these to the length of a day, a month and a year.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By investigating forces on toys and other objects, I can predict the effect on the shape or motion of objects.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By exploring the forces exerted by magnets on other magnets and magnetic materials, I can contribute to the design of a game.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I can describe an electrical circuit as a continuous loop of conducting materials. I can combine simple components in a series circuit to make a game or model.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Forces, electricity and waves: Vibrations and waves
statements.text: By collaborating in experiments on different ways of producing sound from vibrations, I can demonstrate how to change the pitch of the sound.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: By researching, I can describe the position and function of the skeleton and major organs of the human body and discuss what I need to do to keep them healthy.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I have explored my senses and can discuss their reliability and limitations in responding to the environment.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Biological systems: Body systems and cells
statements.text: I know the symptoms of some common diseases caused by germs. I can explain how they are spread and discuss how some methods of preventing and treating disease benefit society.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: By comparing generations of families of humans, plants and animals, I can begin to understand how characteristics are inherited.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: Through exploring properties and sources of materials, I can choose appropriate materials to solve practical challenges.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.strand: Materials: Properties and uses of substances
statements.text: I can make and test predictions about solids dissolving in water and can relate my findings to the world around me.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: Throughout all my learning, I take appropriate action to ensure conservation of materials and resources, considering the impact of my actions on the environment.

statements.subject: Sciences
statements.text: I have contributed to discussions of current scientific news items to help develop my awareness of science.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: I understand that evidence varies in the extent to which it can be trusted and can use this in learning about the past.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: By exploring places, investigating artefacts and locating them in time, I have developed an awareness of the ways we remember and preserve Scotland’s history.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: I can use evidence to recreate the story of a place or individual of local historical interest.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: I can compare aspects of people’s daily lives in the past with my own by using historical evidence or the experience of recreating an historical setting.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: Having selected a significant individual from the past, I can contribute to a discussion on the influence of their actions, then and since.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: I can describe and recreate the characteristics of my local environment by exploring the features of the landscape.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: I can consider ways of looking after my school or community and can encourage others to care for their environment.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: Having explored the variety of foods produced in Scotland, I can discuss the importance of different types of agriculture in the production of these foods.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: By exploring my community and the groups within it, I can identify and consider different types of housing and how they meet needs.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: By using a range of instruments, I can measure and record the weather and can discuss how weather affects my life.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: By exploring climate zones around the world, I can compare and describe how climate affects living things.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: Having explored the landscape of my local area, I can describe the various ways in which land has been used.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: By exploring a natural environment different from my own, I can discover how the physical features influence the variety of living things.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.text: Through activities in my local area, I have developed my mental map and sense of place. I can create and use maps of the area.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I understand that evidence varies in the extent to which it can be trusted and can use this in learning about current issues in society.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I can contribute to a discussion of the difference between my needs and wants and those of others around me.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: By exploring the ways in which we use and need rules, I can consider the meaning of rights and responsibilities and discuss those relevant to me.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I have participated in decision making and have considered the different options available in order to make decisions.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I have developed an understanding of the importance of local organisations in providing for the needs of my local community.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I can work out the amount of money I need to buy items, understanding that I may not always be able to afford the items I want.

statements.subject: Social studies
statements.strand: People in society, economy and business
statements.text: I have experienced the different jobs involved in running a business enterprise and understand the role each one plays in its success.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Digital Literacy: Using digital products and services in a variety of contexts to achieve a purposeful outcome
statements.text: I can explore and experiment with digital technologies and can use what I learn to support and enhance my learning in different contexts.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Digital Literacy: Searching, processing and managing information responsibly
statements.text: Using digital technologies responsibly I can access, retrieve and use information to support, enrich or extend learning in different contexts.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Digital Literacy: Cyber resilience and internet safety
statements.text: I can extend my knowledge of how to use digital technology to communicate with others and I am aware of ways to keep safe and secure.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Food and Textile Technology: Food and Textile
statements.text: I can use a range of simple food preparation techniques when working with food

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Food and Textile Technology: Food and Textile
statements.text: I can use a range of tools and equipment when working with textiles

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Food and Textile Technology: Food and Textile
statements.text: I am developing and using problem solving strategies to meet challenges with a food or textile focus

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Food and Textile Technology: Food and Textile
statements.text: I can adapt and improve ideas and can express my own thinking in different ways

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Technological Developments in Society and Business: Awareness of technological developments (Past, Present and Future), including how they work.
statements.text: I can explore the latest technologies and consider the ways in which they have developed.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Technological Developments in Society and Business: Impact, contribution, and relationship of technologies on business, the economy, politics, and the environment.
statements.text: I can take appropriate action to ensure conservation of materials and resources, considering the impact of my actions on the environment.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Technological Developments in Society and Business: Impact, contribution, and relationship of technologies on business, the economy, politics, and the environment.
statements.text: I understand how technologies help provide for our needs and wants, and how they can affect the environment in which we live.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Craft, Design, Engineering and Graphics: Design and construct models/product
statements.text: I can design and construct models and explain my solutions.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Craft, Design, Engineering and Graphics: Exploring uses of materials
statements.text: I can recognise a variety of materials and suggest an appropriate material for a specific use.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Craft, Design, Engineering and Graphics: Representing ideas, concepts and products through a variety of graphic media
statements.text: I can explore and experiment with sketching, manually or digitally, to represent ideas in different learning contexts.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Craft, Design, Engineering and Graphics: Application of Engineering
statements.text: I explore and discover engineering disciplines and can create solutions.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Computing Science: Understanding the world through computational thinking
statements.text: I can explore and comment on processes in the world around me making use of core computational thinking concepts and can organise information in a logical way.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Computing Science: Understanding and analysing computing technology
statements.text: I understand the instructions of a visual programming language and can predict the outcome of a program written using the language.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Computing Science: Understanding and analysing computing technology
statements.text: I understand how computers process information.

statements.subject: Technologies
statements.strand: Computing Science: Designing, building and testing computing solutions
statements.text: I can demonstrate a range of basic problem solving skills by building simple programs to carry out a given task, using an appropriate language.
